actual: R13A requires exactly two frozen predictions (R12P equal and LGBM baseline) crossed with four sector-risk policy modes, for eight CPU pred-backtest children. The current combine-backtest request applies one global backtest_config and automatically expands LOO tasks for rosters larger than two, so it cannot select exact source tasks or attach per-child strategy_kwargs without producing extra children. Add an explicit auditable prediction-task matrix with per-child overrides, durable identity/restart/archive preservation, and backward-compatible legacy behavior when absent. Scope is QE multi-alpha backend/tests/design only; no training, GPU telemetry, DB schema, non-QE modules, service restart, or research approval gates.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
